resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts places Mamie and Thelma Jardine at Kelly Mountain in 1943. A La Crosse Tribune item quoted on the Forest Lookouts Kootenai County page places the Jardine sisters on Coeur d'Alene mountain for a second season. The record keeps the 1943 Kelly Mountain entry and reports both accounts without choosing.

notes_for_editor: Built 1934 and destroyed 1950 agree across four sources, and the visitor's page is independent of the databases. The 1943 Jardine staffing conflicts in place with the Forest Lookouts quote about Coeur d'Alene mountain, so the story reports both. The firelookout.com Initial Peak entry uses identical wording (1934 30' pole L-4 tower, destroyed 1950), so one of the two may be a copy; check before publication. The visitor's site page is undated, so the footings and view description may not reflect current conditions. No source gives a cause for the 1950 destruction.
